description: Default-deny baseline for the main window. Only the Companion-authored commands plus the minimum core event/window controls are exposed; fs, shell, http, dialog, and notification plugins are deliberately absent. Webview-level media access (getUserMedia / getDisplayMedia) is governed by the OS picker and the in-app media_permissions.json gate — no Tauri capability is required to acquire them. See ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/MEDIA-PERMISSIONS.md.
